int find_gcd(int x, int y)
{
    int gcd = (x > y) ? x : y;
    while (true)
    {
        if (x % gcd == 0 && y % gcd == 0)
            break;
        gcd--;
    }
    return gcd;
}

void diff(double x, double y, double a, double b, double &num, double &den)
{
    num = fabs(x * b - y * a);
    den = y * b;
}

    int g = find_gcd(num, den);
    if (g != 1)
    {
        num = num / g;
        den = den / g;
    }
}

int main()
{

    double best = 1000000.0;
    int best_num = 0;
    int best_den = 0;

    cin >> x >> y >> n;

    {
        int g = find_gcd((int)x, (int)y);

            temp = temp_num / temp_den;

                best_den = (int)b;
                best = temp;
            }

                {
                    best_num = (int)floor(a);
                    best_den = (int)b;
                }

            temp = temp_num / temp_den;

            if (temp < best)

                best = temp;
            }

                }
